title: 9 Places a Godly Man's Hidden Life Shows Up Anyway
caption:
You think the private stuff stays private. It doesn't.

It leaks out in how you talk to the waiter, how you flinch when someone grabs your phone, how short you get on four hours of sleep.

"Nothing is covered up that will not be revealed." Luke 12:2

That verse sounds like a threat until you realize it's an invitation. What you confess starts to die. What you hide keeps growing.

Tell one brother this week.
